outcome: median and maximum systolic and diastolic BPs
need for PP readmission for HDP
cohort: 60 postpartum people diagnosed with HDP from 2018 to 2020
finding: Out-of-hospital NSAID use is not associated with worsened PP BP control after hospital discharge among people diagnosed with HDP.
mod_finding: Those who had a history of a cesarean delivery were more likely to be in the highest quartile of NSAID use postpartum.
